questions.question: Can you use radial and bias-ply tires together?

options.text: Yes, you can use them together.
Yes, you can use them together on the front of a vehicle.
No, you should not use them together.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, you should not use them together.
questions.explanation: Do not use radial and bias-ply tires together. All tires on a vehicle must be the same type and size.

questions.question: When backing a trailer, which way should you turn the steering wheel first?

options.text: In the direction you want the trailer to go.
In the opposite direction of where you want the trailer to go.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the opposite direction of where you want the trailer to go.
questions.explanation: When backing without a trailer, turn the wheel in the direction you want to go. With a trailer, turn the wheel in the opposite direction first. Once the trailer starts to turn, turn the wheel the other way to follow the trailer.

questions.question: What should you do when construction workers are close to the road?

options.text: Wait until construction is finished before driving.

questions.explanation: In construction zones, follow the posted speed limit. Slow down even more when workers are near the road.

questions.question: What should you do if another vehicle is tailgating you?
questions.explanation: If a vehicle is tailgating you, create more space in front of your vehicle. This helps you avoid sudden stops that could cause a crash and makes it easier for the other driver to pass. Speeding up will only make things more dangerous.

questions.question: Why should you be careful around a stopped bus?

options.text: You don't need to worry because it is stopped.
You only need to worry if passengers are getting off the bus.
You should be careful whether or not you can see passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should be careful whether or not you can see passengers.
questions.explanation: Always be careful near a stopped bus. Passengers may be nearby, and the bus could block your view of them or their view of you.

questions.question: What does rearward amplification mean?

options.text: The amount of noise from the rear of a vehicle.
How many trailers a tractor can pull.

questions.explanation: Vehicles with trailers can roll over because of the 'crack-the-whip' effect. This effect is caused by rearward amplification.

questions.question: If you see an aggressive driver crash ahead of you, what should you do?

options.text: Block the driver in with your vehicle.
Stop safely away from the crash and tell police about the aggressive behavior.
Pull over and yell at the driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop safely away from the crash and tell police about the aggressive behavior.
questions.explanation: If you see a crash involving an aggressive driver, stop a safe distance away. Wait for police to arrive and tell them what you saw.

questions.question: If your brakes pull to one side when you use them, what does this mean?

options.text: The brakes need to be checked.
The brakes have too much power.

questions.correctAnswerText: The brakes need to be checked.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle pulls to one side when you brake, you may have a brake problem. Have your brakes fixed before driving again. Driving an unsafe vehicle is against the law.

questions.question: How do you use the controlled braking method?

options.text: Press the brakes as hard as you can without locking the wheels.
Press the brakes with about half force.
Press the brakes until the wheels lock.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press the brakes as hard as you can without locking the wheels.
questions.explanation: Controlled braking means pressing the brakes as hard as you can without locking the wheels. If you need to steer while braking, release the brakes, steer, then press the brakes again.

questions.question: What is difficult for vehicles with low clearance underneath?
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings can be difficult for trailers with low clearance. Vehicles with low undersides and long trailers have the most trouble crossing raised railroad crossings.

questions.question: On low bridges:

options.text: Height warnings must always be posted.
Height warnings must be posted at least twice.
Height warnings may be posted, but are not required.

questions.correctAnswerText: Height warnings may be posted, but are not required.
questions.explanation: Height warnings are sometimes posted on low bridges, but not always. If you are unsure if your vehicle will fit under a bridge, drive slowly.

questions.question: What is the minimum size of placards for hazardous materials?
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials placards must be at least 10 and three-quarter inches on each side.

questions.question: Brake fading happens when:

options.text: Brakes are not used often enough.

questions.explanation: Using brakes too much causes them to overheat. When they overheat, they become less effective. This is called "fading."

questions.question: If you are not sure your vehicle will fit under a bridge, you should:

options.text: Swerve as you pass under the bridge.

questions.explanation: If you are not sure your vehicle will fit under a bridge, slow down. If possible, find another route.

questions.question: On an uphill road, gravity will:
questions.explanation: When driving uphill, gravity pulls your vehicle backward and slows it down.

questions.question: Distracted driving:

options.text: Only happens when drivers physically do something, like use a cell phone.
Can happen from mental activities, such as daydreaming.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can happen from mental activities, such as daydreaming.
questions.explanation: Mental distractions are just as dangerous as physical ones. You might look at a hazard but not see it if you are thinking about something else.

questions.question: When are people usually the least alert?
questions.explanation: Most drivers are least alert at night, especially after midnight. Tired driving crashes happen more often at night than any other time.

questions.question: Steering wheel play should not be more than:
questions.explanation: A steering wheel should have no more than 10 degrees of play. This equals about two inches of movement on a 20-inch wheel. More play makes it hard to steer.

questions.question: Where must the ABS malfunction lamp be located on a dolly?
questions.explanation: A dolly with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) must have a yellow malfunction lamp on its left side.

questions.question: What does the trailer air supply control look like?
questions.explanation: The trailer air supply control is an eight-sided red knob on newer vehicles. It controls the tractor protection valve.
